mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce corporate hiring and consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals a broad-based contraction in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from prior month, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion, a sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods during late-cycle expansions when INDPRO is above 110, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising consumer price index above 202.5 (as of t-2mo) signals accelerating inflation that prompts the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 202.5, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher industrial production level (INDPRO) indicates strong manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is above 110, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) below 137,000 (as of t-1mo) signals weakening labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS < 137000, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher real GDP level (GDPC1) indicates a strong economic expansion that boosts corporate profits and investor confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 is above 11500, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
